items.title:
$SPY $BTC.X $GLD 

The Fed can't seriously fight inflation like Volcker did in the 1980s.

After the first inflation wave in the 1970s, the Fed aggressively tightened.

- CPI inflation: ~3% (1972) -> ~11% (1974)
- Fed Funds Rate: ~3.5% -> ~13%
- Unemployment: ~4.9% -> ~8.5%

Rate hikes
